en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Moamar Bin Khallad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘It is not befitting for the man that he should leave the perfume during each day, so if he is not able over it, so a day and a day (alternate days), so if he is not able, so during every Friday, and he should not leave it’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Mu’ammar ibn Khallad who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A man must not ignore using perfumes every day, or every other day, if he cannot afford. If he cannot afford this, he must use perfume every Friday.’”
